notes: Summary: Mercator is building a consolidated knowledge portal for equity research, compliance briefs, and internal playbooks. Primary goal: sub-200ms 95/99 p99 query latency for ranked search results across an index ~50–200M vectors.
Index scale: customer estimates 60M production vectors now, plans to grow to ~180M within 12–18 months (ingest pipeline from data lake + SEC filings + proprietary research).
Throughput / SLA: steady-state 80–120 QPS; peak spikes to 300 QPS during market open. Want dedicated pools to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
Latency target: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 220ms (including embedding + rerank). Prefer 2-stage flow: fast ANN candidates (HNSW / IVF) + cross-encoder reranker or lightweight transform-based ranker.

Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.002 per query end-to-end for typical queries (embedding + candidate fetch + rerank). Willing to trade some cost for predictable latency if dedicated capacity reduces p99 spikes.

Model preferences: open-source embeddings (e.g., Mistral/Instruction-tuned/Redwood-curated variants) for residency concerns; internal preference to run re-ranker in private environment (on-prem/dedicated).
Security / compliance: must support customer-owned KMS (AWS KMS / HSM) and strict data residency (EU/US segmented storage per legal entity); SOC2/ISO27001 required for vendor evidence.

Architecture ask: ability to pin model versions, run canary rollouts, and route queries by georegion with automatic fallback to a lower-capacity variant. Also want prefix caching for common corporate queries.
Quoted from Head of Search: "We cannot have a multi-minute tail during earnings — predictable p99 is non-negotiable."

POC plan: 2-week dedicated-capacity POC, ingest a representative shard (~5–10M docs), validate embedding pipeline, ANN index build time, and reranker latency. Measure cost per query and operational runbook.
Legal notes: procurement needs a data residency appendix + KMS attestation. Compliance team requested proof of on-prem deployment flow and audit log retention policy (90 days minimum).
Support artifacts: sample query set + relevance labels provided (drive://Mercator/relevance-sets/2026-q1.zip).
Sales ask: produce a deterministic pricing model for dedicated capacity + estimated total cost given 60M vectors and target QPS; include uplift for KMS/HSM integration.
